hook:
Everyone I know who quit tracking
quit at the same moment:

beats.reason: Scrolling a list of near-identical entries for one bowl of soup is where the habit dies, not the calories.

beats.claim: The portion field they guessed at anyway
beats.reason: If you are inventing the grams, the precision was never real, so I stopped asking for it.

beats.claim: Nothing to search, nothing to pick
beats.reason: Say the meal in plain language and the numbers get worked out on the other side of the screen.
